jan.name: Jan Hussing
jan.tag: Connecting German industrial leadership to MEA's sovereign and political decision-making landscape.
jan.bio: Jan Hussing brings deep expertise in the geopolitical and geoeconomic dynamics of the Middle East and Africa. His work focuses on the intersection of industrial strategy, sovereign investment flows, and governmental policy — providing Club members with analytical clarity on the forces shaping MEA's long-term investment environment.
exp: Geopolitical risk assessment across MEA jurisdictions
Sovereign wealth and governmental investment strategies
Policy frameworks and regulatory navigation
Germany–MEA bilateral economic relations
Strategic advisory at government-to-business level
jan.bg: With extensive experience advising senior executives and institutional investors on MEA market entry and expansion, Jan translates complex geopolitical developments into actionable intelligence for Club members.

reg.name: Regional Advisor
reg.tag: Navigating sovereign capital flows and institutional investment frameworks across the MEA region.
reg.bio: Our regional investment advisor specialises in sovereign wealth strategies and institutional investment frameworks across the Gulf and broader MEA, with direct relationships across major sovereign investment authorities.
exp: Sovereign wealth fund strategies and priorities
Public–private partnership structures in MEA
Capital deployment frameworks in emerging MEA markets
Investment authority relationship management
Cross-border deal structuring and advisory
reg.bg: This advisory role draws on deep institutional relationships built over years of engagement with MEA's principal investment authorities. Members benefit from a trusted channel to sovereign capital conversations.

leg.name: Legal Advisor
leg.tag: Protecting German industrial interests through precision regulatory navigation across MEA jurisdictions.
leg.bio: Our MEA legal advisor provides members with on-the-ground expertise in the regulatory, compliance, and licensing frameworks that govern industrial operations across the region. From free zone structures to bilateral investment treaties.
exp: Free zone structures and incorporation strategies
Bilateral investment treaty frameworks
Regulatory compliance and licensing across MEA
Contract law across key MEA jurisdictions
JV formation and acquisition legal structures
leg.bg: Practising across multiple MEA jurisdictions, our legal advisor has advised on market entry, JV formation, and large-scale procurement engagements.

eco.name: Economic Analyst
eco.tag: Translating MEA's structural economic dynamics into investment-grade intelligence for Club members.
eco.bio: Our economic analyst delivers proprietary research on sectoral underrepresentation, supply-demand imbalances, and structural investment opportunities across MEA markets — the analytical engine powering the Club's intelligence offering.
exp: Sectoral demand–supply gap analysis across MEA
Market entry feasibility and opportunity mapping
Competitive landscape assessments by jurisdiction
Tender pipeline intelligence and prioritisation
Trade flow and logistics infrastructure analysis
eco.bg: Our economic analyst ensures that Club members receive intelligence that goes beyond publicly available data — identifying asymmetries only visible to those with deep regional knowledge.
